newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Indian trading company STC to invest in Israel.
newsitem.headline: Indian trading company STC to invest in Israel.

text.p: India's State Trade Corp (STC) received permission from its government to invest $1.23 million in a textile company in Israel, Israel's Ministry of Industry and Trade said in a statement on Wednesday.

The STC is a government trading company with annual turnover of $1.5 billion, the ministry said. Government companies in India need to get permission before making foreign investments above a certain amount.
STC's investment will buy it a 25 percent stake in the Beersheba-based Arihant company, owned by Indian businessman Dipak Jain.

The company was set up to produce textile products for export to the United States and Europe and the factory will be working at full capacity within two months, the ministry said. The plant has received approved enterprise status from Israel's Investment Centre.
Meir Eshet, economic advisor to Israel's embassy in India, said STC was considering the possibility of increasing its activity in Israel.
